question: The perimeter of a square field is double the circumference of a circular field. If the area of the square field is 193600 m², then what will be the area of the circular field (in m²) (Use π = (22)/(7))?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the side of the square be a and the radius of the circle be r.

Given: Perimeter of square = 2 × Circumference of circle ⇒ 4a = 2 × (2πr) ⇒ a = πr

Area of square = a² = (πr)² = π²r²

Area of circle = πr² = Area of square ÷ π

⇒ Area of circle = 193600 × (7 / 22) = 61600 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 61600 m².**
